record.label: Time evolution in the 500-run stopping-power protocol
record.statement: The protocol estimates stopping power from the slope of the mean projectile kinetic energy as a function of time. It samples the kinetic energy 50 times at each of $t=1,\ldots,10$ a.u.
record.boundary: The theorems cover time evolution and its cost over the 500 runs. State preparation, projectile kinetic-energy measurement and the statistical error of the slope estimate lie outside those statements.
